note: Re-judged 2026-10-02 (BGP c22 judge). Genuine negative added: TestRFC9552NativeLinkNonDefaultTopologyNotCollapsed feeds one IS-IS link in topologies 0, 2, 2 and asserts exactly two Link NLRIs, each with exactly one TLV 263, MT-IDs {0,2}: a producer collapsing onto the default topology or dropping 263 on the topology-2 NLRI goes red. Positive TestRFC9552NativeLinkNonDefaultTopology asserts 263 = MT-ID 2; its inline negative tag still re-asserts the same value and proves nothing on its own. Over-constraint noted: the negative also requires TLV 263 with MT-ID 0 on the default-topology NLRI, which RFC 9552 does not require (only the non-default case is a MUST). Revert records on encodeNativeLink observed red.
